        ready=[e for e in events if e['event']=='ready'];complete=[e for e in events if e['event']=='complete']
        assert len(ready)==len(complete)==1
        r,c=ready[0],complete[0];n=r['rows'];engine,lane=r['operation'].split('-')
        expected_stderr=(f"Sampling process {r['pid']} for 3 seconds with 1 millisecond of run time between samples\n"
                         "Sampling completed, processing symbols...\n"
                         f"Sample analysis of process {r['pid']} written to file {folder}/{result['case']}.sample.txt\n")
        assert stderr==(expected_stderr if run['profile'] else '')
        fixture=[(i,float(i),i%2==0) for i in range(n)]
        assert r['input_sha256']==digest(fixture)

        assert c['final_rows']==n and c['connection_closed'] and c['process_peak_rss_bytes']<2**31
        assert r['driver_sha256']==identity['harness']['sqlite_composite_profile.py']
        assert r['original_sha256']==identity['harness']['workloads/sqlite_composite_v0816.py']
        assert set(r['thread_environment'].values())=={'1'}
        assert engine=='alopex' and r['native']=={'alopex':identity['builds'][run['side']]['package']['_alopex.abi3.so']['sha256']}
        for event,count in [('plan_sample',24),('sample',0 if run['profile'] else 24),('phase_sample',24 if lane=='checked' and not run['profile'] else 0)]:
            samples=[e for e in events if e['event']==event]

                else: assert e['total_ns']>0
        if not run['profile']: assert c['iterations']==24
        cell=dict(side=run['side'],trial=run['trial'],profile=run['profile'],case=result['case'],ready=r,complete=c,result=result,events=events)

            cell['python_profile']=(folder/(result['case']+'.client.profile.txt')).read_text()

            assert 'Call graph:' in cell['native_profile']

summary=[]
for side in ['before','after']:

        times=[statistics.median(e['total_ns'] for e in c['events'] if e['event']=='sample' and e['phase']=='measure')/1e6 for c in group]
        measured=[e for c in group for e in c['events'] if e['event']=='sample' and e['phase']=='measure']
        center=statistics.median(e['total_ns'] for e in measured)
        phase_times={name:[statistics.median(e['intervals_ns'][name] for e in c['events'] if e['event']=='phase_sample' and e['phase']=='measure')/1e6 for c in group] for name in phases} if case.endswith('checked') else {}
        summary.append(dict(side=side,case=case,trial_medians_ms=times,median_ms=statistics.median(times),pooled_mad_ms=statistics.median(abs(e['total_ns']-center) for e in measured)/1e6,median_cpu_ms=statistics.median(e['operation_cpu_seconds'] for e in measured)*1000,input_blocks=sum(e['operation_input_blocks'] for e in measured),output_blocks=sum(e['operation_output_blocks'] for e in measured),process_peak_rss_bytes=max(c['complete']['process_peak_rss_bytes'] for c in group),phase_trial_medians_ms=phase_times,phase_medians_ms={k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in phase_times.items()},plan_median_ms=statistics.median(statistics.median(e['total_ns'] for e in c['events'] if e['event']=='plan_sample' and e['phase']=='measure') for c in group)/1e6))
comparisons=[]
for n in [3,34250]:
    for lane in ['original','checked']:
        b,a=[next(x for x in summary if x['case']==f'embedded-{n}-alopex-{lane}' and x['side']==side) for side in ['before','after']]
        delta=a['median_ms']-b['median_ms'];band=max(.05*b['median_ms'],3*b['pooled_mad_ms'])
        comparisons.append(dict(rows=n,lane=lane,before_ms=b['median_ms'],after_ms=a['median_ms'],change_percent=100*delta/b['median_ms'],diagnostic_band_ms=band,increase_exceeds_band=delta>band,paired_trial_ratios=[y/x for x,y in zip(b['trial_medians_ms'],a['trial_medians_ms'])],phase_changes_percent={k:100*(a['phase_medians_ms'][k]/v-1) for k,v in b['phase_medians_ms'].items()}))
phase_diagnostics=[]
for n in [3,34250]:

        center=statistics.median(before);mad=statistics.median(abs(x-center) for x in before);band=max(.05*b,3*mad)
        phase_diagnostics.append(dict(rows=n,phase=name,before_ms=b,after_ms=a,delta_ms=a-b,pooled_before_mad_ms=mad,diagnostic_band_ms=band,increase_exceeds_band=a-b>band))
analysis=dict(identity=identity,runs=runs,cells=cells,summary=summary,comparisons=comparisons,phase_diagnostics=phase_diagnostics,counts=dict(timed_cells=24,measured_samples=504,warmups=72,profiles=2,workers=26,separate_measured_plan_samples=546,plan_warmups=78,separate_measured_phase_cycles=252,phase_warmup_cycles=36,measured_phase_intervals=1260,warm_phase_intervals=180))
